answer: Under this design, each round the ledger privately hands every account a sable token, and later rounds demand an echo of it from k rounds back. Running 1,000 fakes with 50 live tokens each means 50,000 secrets kept consistent; one wrong echo slashes a 10 copper bond. Colluders cannot pool storage: each token is bound to one account, so an echo surfacing from the wrong account exposes both. An honest agent just keeps one short log.
